newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen weak at opening.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen weak at opening.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open lower on Monday at the start of a week dominated by economic data and Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's further Congressional testimony on Wednesday.
"A lot of numbers are coming in. The market will be coloured by that and we have Greenspan coming up," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities.
"The mood is cautious. We've had three days on the downside." Data on Monday includes January personal income and consumption ahead of the bell and February purchasing agents figures at 1500 GMT.
